text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran llm.int8 (bitsandbytes weight-only) on halcyon14b this morning, wanted to share a first-pass summary :eyes:
sam: nice, what was the setup? single-node A100 or multi-GPU?
maria: single A100-80GB, bnb v0.41, transformers + llm.int8 wrapper. command: ```python run_serving.py --model halcyon14b --quantize weight_only --backend bnb --use_llmint8```
raj: share eval slices please — instruction, code, math, long-context?
maria: ran the usual slices: instr, code, math-std, longctx-4k. quick numbers (baseline fp16 -> llm.int8):
  - overall instr EM-like metric: 88.4% -> 87.1% (delta -1.3%)
  - code pass@1 style: 62.0% -> 60.2% (delta -1.8%)
  - math (short): 71.5% -> 70.9% (delta -0.6%)
  - longctx QA: 54.2% -> 50.8% (delta -3.4%)
  - ppl (eval set): 12.3 -> 13.1 (approx +6.5%)
  - median latency (seq len 512): 280ms -> 120ms (2.33x faster)
  - p95 latency: 520ms -> 260ms
  - GPU mem footprint: ~48GB -> ~18GB
  - throughput (tokens/s): 450 -> 1040

katie: ok interesting — longctx looks like the big regression. any sign it’s kv-cache alignment or attention kernel?
maria: suspect kv-cache quant noise. observed occasional token-doubling on repeat-generation prompts (small, not common).
brian: did you try the llmint8-fix-attn patch we discussed last week?
maria: not yet. this run was stock. planning to test the patch next — also will try mixing residual fp16 for rotary/attn blocks.
raj: can we get per-layer sensitivity? maybe run per-layer reorder quant to see which layers spike the most.
maria: yes will run per-layer mse scan overnight.
eval-bot: quick eval summary uploaded -> https://internal.eval/halcyon14b/1923456789 (contains full slice tables, distributions, and per-seed runs) :white_check_mark:
sam: do we have a deploy decision? Dedicated vs hosted profile?
maria: for now: mark as "int8-weightonly-beta" in model catalog (allowlisted), but default rollout: traffic routed to fp16 for longctx-heavy routes. create fallback policy to fp16 when prompt tokens > 2k or when slice tag == longctx.
katie: add a canary on prod with 5% traffic and eval-hooks for hallucination/regression alerts.
brian: note for infra — llm.int8 kernel pins to CUDA 12.2 in bnb v0.41, seen occasional cudnn warnings. deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2025-11-16T09:00Z -> will create canary cluster with int8 profile (5%)
maria: next steps: (1) run per-layer sensitivity, (2) test attn-fix patch + residual-fp16 mix, (3) re-run eval slices and update catalog scores, (4) prepare rollout document and fallback policy.
raj: if longctx delta stays >2% we should avoid int8 for long-context customers.
sam: thanks — nice first pass. low-hanging win on cost/throughput but gotta solve the longctx behavior before broad rollout. :+1:
